_doc: Hand-written Hinglish skits used ONLY when no free model is reachable (and by test mode). Each is posted at most once. caption = the same words in Roman letters, 1:1.

scripts.title: Mera calendar full hai 📅
scripts.description: Apni company chalana mushkil hai jab poori company aap hi ho.
scripts.topic: the founder cancels his own meetings (Hindi)
scripts.canonical_en: A desi CEO's calendar is full of meetings with himself that he cancels himself

lines.text: जब से मैं अपनी company का CEO बना हूँ, calendar पूरा full है।
lines.caption: jab se main apni company ka CEO bana hoon, calendar poora full hai.

lines.text: दस बजे founder के साथ meeting है।
lines.caption: das baje founder ke saath meeting hai.

lines.text: ग्यारह बजे founder ने meeting cancel कर दी।
lines.caption: gyarah baje founder ne meeting cancel kar di.

lines.text: बारह बजे मैंने founder को warning दे दी।
lines.caption: barah baje maine founder ko warning de di.

lines.text: क्योंकि founder, CEO और intern, सब मैं ही हूँ।
lines.caption: kyunki founder, CEO aur intern, sab main hi hoon.

lines.text: और सच बोलूँ तो company intern ही चला रहा है।
lines.caption: aur sach boloon to company intern hi chala raha hai.

scripts.title: Investor mil gaya 💼
scripts.description: Pitch kiya. Investor ke sawaal the. Aur khana bhi.
scripts.topic: the only investor is his mom (Hindi)
scripts.canonical_en: A desi founder pitches to an investor who turns out to be his mom

lines.text: इस साल आखिरकार मुझे एक investor मिल गया।
lines.caption: is saal aakhirkaar mujhe ek investor mil gaya.

lines.text: उसने पूछा revenue कितना है, team कितनी बड़ी है?
lines.caption: usne poocha revenue kitna hai, team kitni badi hai?

lines.text: मैंने कहा, हम अभी stealth mode में हैं।
lines.caption: maine kaha, hum abhi stealth mode mein hain.

lines.text: बोलीं, पाँच साल का stealth mode सोना कहलाता है।
lines.caption: boli, paanch saal ka stealth mode sona kehlata hai.

lines.text: Investor मेरी मम्मी थीं।
lines.caption: investor meri mummy thi.

lines.text: Funding reject हो गई, पर खाना मिल गया।
lines.caption: funding reject ho gayi, par khana mil gaya.

scripts.title: Mera premium office tour ☕
scripts.description: Fast wifi, city view, zero rent. Log ise cafe kehte hain.
scripts.topic: his premium office is a cafe (Hindi)
scripts.canonical_en: A desi founder shows off his premium office which is a cafe he has been sitting in since Monday

lines.text: हर successful founder को एक premium office चाहिए।
lines.caption: har successful founder ko ek premium office chahiye.

lines.text: मेरे office में fast wifi, unlimited chai और city view है।
lines.caption: mere office mein fast wifi, unlimited chai aur city view hai.

lines.text: Rent बस एक cutting chai रोज़ का है।
lines.caption: rent bas ek cutting chai roz ka hai.

lines.text: Clients को यहाँ मिलना बहुत पसंद है।
lines.caption: clients ko yahan milna bahut pasand hai.

lines.text: क्योंकि ये एक cafe है, और मैं Monday से यहीं बैठा हूँ।
lines.caption: kyunki ye ek cafe hai, aur main Monday se yahin baitha hoon.

lines.text: आज barista ने मुझे employee of the month बना दिया।
lines.caption: aaj barista ne mujhe employee of the month bana diya.

scripts.title: Subah 5 baje wala CEO ⏰
scripts.description: Discipline sab kuch hai. Khaas kar jab karne ko kuch na ho.
scripts.topic: a 5 a.m. routine for a company that does not exist (Hindi)
scripts.canonical_en: A desi founder's strict 5 a.m. routine ends back in bed because the company does not exist yet

lines.text: मैं सुबह पाँच बजे उठता हूँ, क्योंकि empire खुद नहीं बनते।
lines.caption: main subah paanch baje uthta hoon, kyunki empire khud nahi bante.

lines.text: Brush से पहले emails check करता हूँ।
lines.caption: brush se pehle emails check karta hoon.

lines.text: Black coffee पीता हूँ, बिना चीनी, बिना break.
lines.caption: black coffee peeta hoon, bina cheeni, bina break.

lines.text: छह बजे तक मैं desk पर होता हूँ।
lines.caption: chhe baje tak main desk par hota hoon.

lines.text: सात बजे तक वापस bed पर।
lines.caption: saat baje tak wapas bed par.

lines.text: क्योंकि company अभी बनी ही नहीं है।
lines.caption: kyunki company abhi bani hi nahi hai.

scripts.title: Itni badi team kaise sambhalta hoon 🪴
scripts.description: Leadership matlab team ki sunna. Meri team bahut achhi listener hai.
scripts.topic: the CEO's whole team is a potted plant (Hindi)
scripts.canonical_en: A desi CEO brags about handling a big team but the team is a potted plant

lines.text: लोग पूछते हैं, इतनी बड़ी team कैसे संभालते हो?
lines.caption: log poochhte hain, itni badi team kaise sambhalte ho?

lines.text: Simple है, रोज़ सुबह motivational speech देता हूँ।
lines.caption: simple hai, roz subah motivational speech deta hoon.

lines.text: फिर team से feedback लेता हूँ।
lines.caption: phir team se feedback leta hoon.

lines.text: Team बोलती है speech बहुत अच्छी थी।
lines.caption: team bolti hai speech bahut achhi thi.

lines.text: Team एक पौधा है।
lines.caption: team ek paudha hai.

lines.text: फिर भी office मुझसे ज़्यादा आता है।
lines.caption: phir bhi office mujhse zyada aata hai.

scripts.title: Naya chapter shuru 🙏
scripts.description: Kuch log ise naukri jaana kehte hain. Main ise pivot kehta hoon.
scripts.topic: a LinkedIn announcement that is really getting fired (Hindi)
scripts.canonical_en: A humble desi LinkedIn post about a new venture is really about being fired this morning

lines.text: आज मैं बहुत humbled हूँ एक नया chapter शुरू करते हुए।
lines.caption: aaj main bahut humbled hoon ek naya chapter shuru karte hue.

lines.text: सालों की मेहनत के बाद, अब मैं अपना venture शुरू कर रहा हूँ।
lines.caption: saalon ki mehnat ke baad, ab main apna venture shuru kar raha hoon.

lines.text: ना boss, ना office, ना fixed salary.
lines.caption: na boss, na office, na fixed salary.

lines.text: Mostly ना salary.
lines.caption: mostly na salary.

lines.text: आज सुबह company ने मुझे निकाल दिया, मैं इसे pivot बोल रहा हूँ।
lines.caption: aaj subah company ne mujhe nikaal diya, main ise pivot bol raha hoon.
